newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands to respond to Placer offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands to respond to Placer offer.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd said on Tuesday it will respond by January 6 next year to the latest offer by Placer Dome Inc.
Highlands it will consider the proposal over the Christmas period, along with other options.

Placer Dome on Monday revised its offer, saying it was willing to cancel its interest in Highlands and instead pay A$276.8 million for Highlands' 25 percent stake in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.

Prior to the revised offer, Highlands had unanimously resolved to reject a takeover bid by Placer Dome, citing an independent report by Barings Bros Burrows showing Highlands shares to be worth about 40 percent more than Placer's 75 cent per share offer price.
Placer Dome has about 33 percent of Highlands.
Both companies have 25 percent stakes in Porgera, Placer's being held through its listed Placer Pacific Ltd unit.
The other equal 25 percent shareholders in Porgera are Goldfields Ltd and PNG interests.
The PNG interests are held 15 percent by Orogen Minerals Ltd and 10 percent by the government's Minerals Development Resources Corp (MRDC).
The MRDC holds five percent in its own right and five percent for provincial governments and landowners.
Production from the mine should total about 850,000 ounces of gold this year, Highlands managing director Ian Goddard said.
